spans.s:
कद् 1. कद्, cl. 1. A. कदते, -दितुम्, perf.
चकाद, to be confused, suffer mentally; to
grieve; to confound; to kill or hurt; to call; to cry
or shed tears; चकाद कदनम्, he accomplished a
destruction; [cf. Gr. κῆδας; Goth. hatan: cf. also
कन्द्.]

कद् 2. कद्, ind. (originally the neuter form
of the interrogative pronoun क), Ved. a particle of
interrogation, where? कद् is used, like किम्, with the
particles चन and चिद् (e. g. न कच्चन उपब्दिः
शृण्वे रथस्य, not at any time or in any manner
is heard the noise of thy chariot; वेति दिवः-कच्चिद्
आ, he comes from heaven now and then).
—कच्चिद् is
sometimes used, like the simple कद्, as a particle of in-
terrogation (e. g. कच्चिद् दृष्टा त्वया दमयन्ती,
was Damayantī seen by thee?). कच्चिद् may some-
[]
times be equivalent to ‘I hope that’ (e. g. व्याधिर् न
कच्चित् ते शरीरम् प्रतिबाधते, I hope no illness
afflicts thy body).

कद् at the beginning of a compound marks the
uselessness, badness or defectiveness of anything; as in
the following examples.
—कत्-तृण, अम्, n. a fragrant
grass; the plant Pistia Stratiotes.
—कत्-तोय, अम्, n.
an intoxicating drink, wine or vinous spirit.
—कत्-त्रि,
अयस्, m. pl. three inferior articles.
—कद्-अक्षर,
अम्, n. a bad letter, bad writing.
—कद्-अग्नि, इस्, m.
some or a little fire.
—कद्-अध्वन्, आ, m. a bad road.
—कद् अन्न, अम्, n. bad food.
—कद्-अपत्य, अम्,
n. bad posterity; bad children.
—कद्-अभ्यास, अस्,
m. a bad habit.
—कद्-अर्थ, अस्, m. a useless thing;
(अस्, आ, अम्), useless, unmeaning; having what purpose
or aim?
—कदर्थन, अम्, आ, n. f. tormenting,
torture.
—कदर्थय, nom. P. कदर्थयति, -यि-
तुम्, to despise, to estimate lightly; to torment, tor-
ture, trouble.
—कदर्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, despised,
disdained, rejected; rendered useless.
—कदर्थी-
कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to
disdain, despise, to estimate at small value.
—क-
दर्थी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, despised, disdained, ren-
dered useless and unavailing.
—कद्-अर्य, अस्, आ,
अम्, avaricious, miserly; little, insignificant, mean;
bad, disagreeable; (अस्), m. a miser.
—कदर्य-ता,
f. or कदर्य-त्व, अम्, n. avarice; insignificance;
badness.
—कदर्य-भाव, अस्, m. avarice, stingi-
ness.
—कद्-अश्व, अस्, m. a bad horse.
—कद्-आकार,
अस्, आ, अम्, ill-formed, ugly.
—कद्-आख्य, अम्, n.
the plant Costus Speciosus (‘having a bad name,’
i. e. कुष्ठ or दुष्ट).
—कद्-आचार, अस्, आ,
अम्, wicked, abandoned, following evil practices;
(अस्), m. bad conduct.
—कद्-इन्द्रिय, आणि, n. pl.
bad organs of sense.
—कद्-उष्ट्र, अस्, m. a bad
camel.
—कद्-उष्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, tepid, lukewarm;
(अम्), n. warmth, lukewarmness, gentle warmth; [cf.
कवोष्ण, कोष्ण.]
—कद्-रथ, अस्, m. a bad
carriage.
—कद्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, containing the word
क.
—कद्-वद, अस्, आ, अम्, speaking ill or inaccu-
rately or indistinctly; contemptible, vile, base.
—कल्-
लोल, see s. v.

कदन, अम्, n. destruction, killing, slaughter; war,
sin.
—कदन-पुर, अम्, n., N. of a town.
—क-
दन-प्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, loving slaughter.
कदन कदन. See under 1. कद्.
कद क-द, अस्, m. a cloud. See 4. क.

कदा कदा, ind. (fr. 2. क), when? at what
time? (with following fut. or pres. tense); how?
कदा is sometimes found with a following च and
preceding यदा (e. g. यदा कदा च सुनवाम
सोमम्, let us press out the Soma as often as may
be or at all times); कदा चन, (though originally
negative, generally = ) at some time, one day, once;
न कदा चन, never at any time; कदा चित्, at
some time or other, sometimes, once; न कदा चित्,
never; कदापि (कदा-अपि), sometimes, now and
then; न कदापि, never; [cf. Gr. κοτέ and ποτέ
Lat. quando; Lith. kadà; Slav. kogda.]
—कदा-
मत्त, अस्, m., N. of a man.

कदक कदक, अस्, m. an awning; [cf.
कन्दक.]

कदम्ब कदम्ब, अस्, m. (said to be fr. 1.
कद्), the tree Nauclea Cadamba, a tree with orange-
coloured fragrant blossoms; the mustard-seed plant,
Sinapis Dichotoma; a kind of grass, Andropogon
Serratus; a particular mineral substance; turmeric;
(ई), f., N. of a plant; (अम्), n. a multitude, an as-
semblage or collection.
—कदम्ब-पुष्पा or ई, f.
a plant, the flowers of which resemble those of the
Kadamba, commonly called Mandīri.
—कदम्ब-
वायु, उस्, m. a fragrant breeze.
—कदम्बानिल
(˚ब-अन्˚), अस्, m. a fragrant breeze, spring.

कादम्ब कादम्ब, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt.
1. कद्), a kind of goose with dark-grey wings (कल-
हंस); a drake or (according to some) a teal; an
arrow; the plant Nauclea Cadamba; (आ), f., N. of a
plant, = कदम्ब-पुष्पी; (अम्), n. the flower of
the plant Nauclea Cadamba.

कदम्बक, अस्, m. the plant Nauclea Cadamba,
Sinapis Dichotoma, = हरिद्रु; (अम्), n. a multitude.
कादम्बक, अस्, m. an arrow.

कदम्बद, अस्, m. the mustard-seed plant, Si-
napis Dichotoma.

कदर कदर, अस्, m. a saw; an iron goad
for guiding an elephant; N. of a tree, which may be
substituted for Khadira as a sacrificial post; a white
sort of Mimosa; (अस्, अम्), m. n. a corn, a callosity
of the feet caused by external friction; (अम्), n. coagu-
lated milk; [cf. कङ्कर, कच्चर, कटुर, &c.]

कदल कदल, अस्, ई, m. f. the plantain tree
(Musa Sapientum), called also banana. It has a soft
perishable stem, poetically a symbol of the frailty of
human life; (आ), f., N. of several plants, Pistia Stra-
tiotes; Bombax Heptaphyllum; (ई), f. a kind of deer,
the hide of which is used as a seat &c.; a flag, a
banner, a flag carried by an elephant.
—कदली-
स्कन्ध, अस्, m. a kind of illusion.

कदलक, अस्, m. the plantain or banana tree,
Musa Sapientum.
कदलिन्, ई, m. a kind of antelope.

कदलीक्षता कदलीक्षता, f. a sort of cu-
cumber; a fine woman.
कदूहि कदूहि, इस्, m., N. of a man.

कद्रु कद्रु, उस्, उस् or ऊस्, उ (said to be fr. rt.
कव्), tawny, reddish-brown; (उस्), m. tawny (the
colour); N. of a Ṛṣi; (ऊस्), f. a Soma vessel (?); a
personification described in certain legends which re-
late to the bringing down of the Soma from heaven,
according to the Brāhmaṇas ‘the earth personified;’ N.
of a daughter of Dakṣa, wife of Kaśyapa and mother
of the Nāgas or the serpent-race; N. of a plant.
—क-
द्रु-पुत्र, अस्, m. or कद्रु-सुत, अस्, m. a serpent.

कद्र्यच् कद्र्यच्, आङ्, कद्रीची, अक् (fr. 2. क
and rt. अञ्च्), Ved. turned towards what?
कद्वत् कद्-वत्. See under 2. कद्.

कद्वर कद्वर, अम्, n. whey; buttermilk
mixed with water; [cf. कङ्कर, कच्चर, कटुर,
कट्वर, and कदर.]
कादम्बिनी, f. a long line or bank of clouds.

कादम्बर कादम्बर, अस्, अम्, m. n. the
surface or skim of coagulated milk; (अम्, ई), n. f. a
spirituous liquor distilled from the flowers of the
Cadamba; the rain-water which collects in clefts or
hollow places of the tree Nauclea Cadamba when the
flowers are in perfection, and which is supposed to be
impregnated with the honey; wine, spirituous liquor
in general; the fluid which issues from the temples
of a rutting elephant; (ई), f. the female of the
Kokila or Indian cuckoo; the female of another bird,
= शारिका, i. e. Turdus Salica; an epithet of Saras-
vatī; N. of a daughter of Citra-ratha and Madirā;
a celebrated work of Vāṇa-bhaṭṭa, called ‘Kādambarī,’
derives its name from her.
—कादम्बरी-वीज, अम्,
n. ferment, yeast, whatever occasions fermentation.

कादम्बर्य, अस्, m. = कदम्ब, Nauclea Ca-
damba.

कादाचित्क कादाचित्क, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कदा-
चिद्), appearing now and then, produced sometimes,
occasional, incidental.
—कादाचित्क-ता, f. the state
of occurring occasionally.

कादिक्रमस्तुति कादि-क्रम-स्तुति, a work
attributed to Śaṅkarācārya.
कादि-मत, a Tantra work.

काद्रवेय काद्रवेय, अस्, m. (fr. कद्रू),
epithet of the Nāgas or serpents supposed to people
the lower regions; an epithet of Arbuda; also of
Kasarṇīra.

काद्रव, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कद्रु), dark-yellow, of
a reddish-brown colour.
